<!--
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(web): sign-in form no longer submits twice".
Solve one underlying problem per PR.
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and
reproduction steps or environment where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it spans apps or packages,
explain why those changes are needed for the same fix. Split independent fixes. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused tests or manual checks you ran and the observed results
for the changed behavior. State anything you could not check. "Tests pass" alone
is insufficient.

For UI changes, include before/after screenshots. Include a short recording
when motion, timing, transitions, or interaction details matter. Upload evidence
to GitHub and embed or link it here. Never commit PR-only assets. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
